title: hushrun.run/v2
description: Output of `hushrun run --format json`: each check run, failed or skipped, and the event recorded for it. [M8] Whether the checks ran isolated, and per check the custody its evidence claims, the environment it ran in. [ADR 0062] v2 has no stage.

event.description: The key of the event recorded for it; null when it was skipped, and [ADR 0032] when the server refused the event for the org's plan (L-5): then `detail` ends with `; not recorded`, and `custody` and `environment` are null too.

custody.description: [M8] The custody the recorded event claims; null when nothing was recorded.

environment.description: [M8] The recorded environment (E-7): image, platform, network, runner.
